text:
alice: quick q — proposal to add a small latency-budget header from SDKs to help console surface per-request SLOs. sketch below. thoughts?
ben: pinging infra and eng-platform folks. What's the exact header name and semantics?
carmen: +1 on surface. We need to be careful about fallout for existing routing policies that check headers. can it be optional? :thinking:
dana: optional and opt-in makes sense. maybe `X-Redwood-Latency-Budget-ms` with integer ms, max 0-10000? if absent, routing uses default latency class.
alice: yep optional. default behavior: no header => router uses configured route priority. header present => try to honor budget when choosing region/model variant, but only as a hint (best-effort). fallback always allowed.
ben: two deployment concerns: (1) telemetry - we must not explode metrics cardinality by adding too many unique values, (2) policy engine needs quick path for hints.
carmen: telemetry idea: bucket budgets into ranges before emitting: 0-50,50-150,150-300,300-1000,1000+. then console widget shows distribution and tail latency vs bucket. minimizes cardinality.
dana: SDKs: expose a simple API: `client.withLatencyBudget(200)` that sets header for that request context. also allow global config `defaultLatencyBudget`. PRs for py/ts/go will need small compat shims.
alice: sample header snippet we discussed: ```http
X-Redwood-Latency-Budget-ms: 200
```
ben: for rollout: feature-flag the header emission behind server-side toggle + SDK opt-in. start with devex and internal customers.
carmen: on routing side, make sure routing logs include `latency_budget_bucket` to help debug early rollout. add to tracing too.
dana: question: should the console have an explicit chart for requests that set a budget vs not? I think yes, helps validate adoption.
alice: agreed. UX: show two lines on p50/p95 graphs, and a small banner about "suggested budget" based on route characteristics.
ben: backwards compat: if SDKs send value that router can't interpret (too big/negative) -> clamp to nearest bucket and emit a warn metric, but don't reject request.
carmen: tests: add e2e that sends budgets 1ms, 100ms, 1s and assert route selection falls back gracefully. also add unit tests for bucketing.
dev-bot: deploy check: lint + integration tests passed for proto change (no schema break). :white_check_mark:
alice: plan: I'll draft RFC with header semantics, bucketing map, SDK API sketch, rollout plan (feat-flag + internal opt-in + 2-week telemetry burn). feedback welcome before EOD tomorrow.
ben: SGTM. I'll coordinate with eng-platform on a cheap fast-path in policy engine.
dana: will take the Go/TS SDK PRs after RFC.
carmen: will update console mockups once RFC lands.
alice: thanks all :heart:
